# Templates and Content Generation (`templates`)

Auto-generated schema reference for the `templates` module. See [../tools.generated.md](../tools.generated.md) for the full registry index.

### template_list

**List templates**

List the files directly inside the top-level folder named exactly "templates" (case-sensitive; not recursive). The folder set in the Templates or Templater plugin is not used; use vault_list to look elsewhere.

#### Input

_No input parameters._

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | string[] | Vault-relative paths of the files directly in the top-level "templates" folder; empty when that folder is missing. |

#### Example

Request (`tools/call` params):

```json
{
  "name": "template_list",
  "arguments": {}
}
```

Response (`structuredContent`):

```json
{
  "files": [
    "templates/meeting.md"
  ]
}
```

### template_create_from

**Create file from template**

Create a file by expanding {{variable}} placeholders in a template, optionally setting frontmatter keys on it in the same call. Missing parent folders are created.
See also:
- template_expand — to get the expanded text without writing a file.
Errors:
- "File not found" if templatePath is missing.
- "File already exists" if destPath is taken.
- "Frontmatter can only be set on Markdown (.md) files" if frontmatter is given for a non-.md destPath.

#### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templatePath` | string (1–4096) | yes | Vault-relative file path with extension, e.g. `notes/a.md`. |
| `destPath` | string (1–4096) | yes | Vault-relative file path with extension, e.g. `notes/a.md`. |
| `variables` | object | no | Values for {{name}} placeholders, overriding the built-ins {{date}} (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD), {{time}} (host-locale) and {{title}} ("Untitled"). Unknown placeholders and Templater <% %> stay as written. |
| `frontmatter` | object | no | Keys to set on the new note, mapped to JSON-compatible values (string, number, boolean, null, array or object). Applied after expansion: template keys are kept, keys given here overwrite them. Markdown (.md) destinations only. |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | Vault-relative path of the new file. |
| `templatePath` | string | Vault-relative path of the template that was used. |
| `frontmatter` | object | The new note's whole frontmatter after the frontmatter parameter was applied. Present only when frontmatter was given. |
| `modified` | string | New last-modification time (ISO-8601); pass it as the next expectedMtime. |

#### Example

Request (`tools/call` params):

```json
{
  "name": "template_create_from",
  "arguments": {
    "templatePath": "templates/meeting.md",
    "destPath": "meetings/m1.md",
    "variables": {
      "title": "Weekly"
    },
    "frontmatter": {
      "status": "draft"
    }
  }
}
```

Response (`structuredContent`):

```json
{
  "path": "meetings/m1.md",
  "templatePath": "templates/meeting.md",
  "frontmatter": {
    "status": "draft"
  },
  "modified": "2026-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"
}
```

### template_expand

**Expand template inline**

Expand {{variable}} placeholders in a given string without writing any file.
See also:
- template_create_from — to write the expanded template to a new file.

#### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string (≤100000) | yes | Template text with {{variable}} placeholders. |
| `variables` | object | no | Values for {{name}} placeholders, overriding the built-ins {{date}} (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD), {{time}} (host-locale) and {{title}} ("Untitled"). Unknown placeholders and Templater <% %> stay as written. |

#### Output

_No `structuredContent` declared — returns plain text or binary._

#### Example

Request (`tools/call` params):

```json
{
  "name": "template_expand",
  "arguments": {
    "template": "Hi {{name}}",
    "variables": {
      "name": "Ada"
    }
  }
}
```

Response (`content`):

Text block:

```text
Hi Ada
```
